text.en:
Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness

<solar/>Solar Kills while standing in a <solar/>Sunspot create a <solar/>Sunspot at the target's location.

Grants 350% Additional Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate if your <solar/>Solar Super is Charged.

While a <solar/>Solar Super is equipped and fully charged, any Ability Kill (even Unpowered Melees) grants <solar/>Cure x2 and one stack of 'Sunfire Furnace' for 20 seconds. Glaive melees do not count. Maximum of 10 stacks.

While Sunfire Furnace is active, kills with your <solar/>Shieldburst Barricade or <bold ANY /> Grenade trigger an <solar/>Ignition (yes, even Forerunner's "The Rock").

Sunfire Furnace also grants Increased Super Damage and Additional Base Grenade and Class Ability Regneration rate at 1|2|3... stacks.
• 6.5%|13.6%|22%|32%|43%|57%|73%|93%|118%|150%| Increased Super Damage
• ?|?|?|?|?|?|?|?|?|250% Base Grenade and Class Ability Regeneration

Casting your Super freezes the amount of stacks you have. Refund 8%|20%|26%|33%|45% Super Energy upon exiting at 1|2|3|4|5+ stacks of Sunfire Furnace.

While a <solar/>Solar Super is equipped and fully charged, ability kills (including Unpowered Melees, excluding glaive melees) grant <solar/>Cure x2 and stacks of 'Sunfire Furnace' <link based on Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />. Minor Tier enemies grant 1 stack, while Elite and Higher tier enemies grant 2. Stacks last for 20 seconds. Maximum of 10 stacks.
